message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta.  
Here’s how:

| Step | What to do | Contact / Link |
|------|------------|----------------|
| 1 | **Call 311** – Atlanta’s non-emergency hotline. The operator will connect you to the appropriate department (usually the Police Department’s Noise Enforcement Unit). | 311 (or 404‑555‑1234) |
| 2 | **Use the online portal** – Atlanta’s official website offers a “Report a Problem” form where you can submit noise complaints electronically. | https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 |
| 3 | **Visit the Police Department’s website** – Some cities allow you to fill out a specific noise complaint form online. | https://www.atlantapd.org/ |
| 4 | **Go to your local precinct** – If you prefer in person, you can visit the nearest police station and speak with a dispatcher. | Find your precinct at https://www.atlantapd.org/precincts |

**What information you’ll need:**

- Your name and contact details (optional but helpful)
- Date, time, and duration of the disturbance
- Exact location (address or intersection)
- Description of the noise (e.g., loud music, barking dogs, construction)
- Any evidence you have (photos, videos, audio recordings)

**After filing:**  
The police will investigate and may issue a warning or citation depending on the severity and frequency of the disturbance. If the problem persists, you can follow up with the city’s code enforcement office.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like help drafting a formal complaint or locating the nearest precinct!
